note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-5 English Wikipedia article on the Willys MB. Every value is grade claimed and the registry marks primary_held false. The article is a secondary compilation and is not a primary source.

curb_weight_kg.locator: Infobox, weight row, curb weight entry
curb_weight_kg.state: curb weight published as 2,453 lb with engine fluids and full fuel; pounds converted to kilograms, 1 lb = 0.45359237 kg; the infobox also publishes a 2,337 lb dry weight

length_mm.state: length published as 132 in; inches converted to millimetres

width_mm.state: width published as 62 in; inches converted to millimetres

height_mm.locator: Infobox, height row, top up entry
height_mm.state: height published as 69 3/4 in with the top up, reducible to 52 in; inches converted to millimetres

ground_clearance_mm.state: ground clearance published as 8 3/4 in; inches converted to millimetres

engine_model.state: engine published as a 134 cu in inline 4 Willys L134 Go Devil, as published

engine_displacement_l.state: engine displacement published as 134 cu in; cubic inches converted to litres and rounded to the published precision 2.2 L

published_power_hp.state: gross engine power published as 60 hp, with a 54 hp net rating; the gross figure recorded and the basis stated; maximum rating, no net basis

transmission_type.state: transmission published as a 3-speed with a 2-range transfer case, a manual

max_speed_kmh.state: speed published as 65 mph; miles per hour converted to km/h, 1 mph = 1.609344 km/h
